+title: 'git: GitCapability, GitContext, and withGit(root:)'
+---
+## Goal
+
+Make the base of the `git` capability (git.md, "Proposed shape", decisions 8 and 9). It has no verb yet. Each verb task adds its verb to `GitCapability.tools`.
+
+## Where
+
+- Model: `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Files/FilesCapability.swift` and `FileContext.swift`.
+- Builder short forms: `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Surface/MultiToolBuilder+Capabilities.swift` (`withFiles`).
+- Path rules: `Capabilities/Files/PathGuard.swift`.
+
+## Work
+
+1. New folder `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Git/`.
+2. `GitCapability: Capability` with `noun = "git"` and `tools: [any Tool]`. Off by default.
+3. `GitContext`: holds the root, one `PathGuard` with the same rules as `files`, and the repository that contains the root (opened through SwiftGitX). The root can be a subfolder of the repository. Give a helper that changes a repository path into a path relative to the root, and the other way.
+4. If the root is not in a repository, do not throw at construction. Each verb answers a `correction` in band ("the root is not in a git repository").
+5. `MultiTool.Builder.withGit(root:)`: the short form of `withCapability(GitCapability(root:))`.
+6. Test support: a helper that makes a temporary repository for one test (init, write files, commit, branch). Put it where the unit tests and the integration tests can use it (see `MultitoolTestSupport` in `Package.swift`). The helper can use SwiftGitX to make commits.
+
+## Tests
+
+- `withGit(root:)` claims the `tools.git` namespace; a second registration fails at `buildRegistry()`.
+- A host with no `withGit` renders no `tools.git`.
+- A root in a subfolder finds the repository above it.
+- A root outside any repository gives no throw at build time.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `swift build` and `swift test` pass with no new warnings. #git
\ No newline at end of file
